functions.name: ask-research-question
functions.description: Submit a natural-language question for asynchronous AI research and return the token used to retrieve progress and the answer.

question.description: Natural-language research question; ordinary Unicode text, not a serialized request body.

FunctionInput_statista_askresearchquesti.description: The natural-language question to submit for asynchronous research.

researchToken.description: Opaque token identifying the submitted research question; use with get-research-answer.

FunctionOutput_statista_askresearchquest.description: The token acknowledging research submission, not completion.

tags.instructions: Use to start new research, not to retrieve an existing answer. Keep the returned researchToken and pass it to `get-research-answer`. Submission does not mean the answer is ready. Repeating the same question may start another research request; do not retry blindly after an ambiguous result.

mediaType.description: Response Content-Type media type if supplied; omitted rather than guessed.

byteLength.description: Number of decoded file bytes, computed from the received body.

contentBase64.description: RFC 4648 standard padded base64 of the exact downloaded binary bytes.

FunctionOutput_statista_downloadreport.description: One downloaded report file represented by its exact bytes in base64 and available response metadata.

tags.instructions: Use a report-bearing study id from `list-studies`. Optionally inspect formats with `get-report-files` first. Select pdf, ppt, or xls; this tool resolves the provider file reference for you. The returned contentBase64 represents exact binary bytes, not ordinary text. This retrieves one file, not an export of the report catalog.

year.description: Compilation calendar year as YYYY, not an instant or full date.

respondents.description: Absolute respondent count for the cell.

data.description: Map of provider row/group labels to ordered cells; keys preserved exactly.

valueUnit.description: Unit or symbol for numeric values, such as %.
